messages:
carl_support: FYI — Acme reported their org (org_acme_42) dashboards showing tokens/sec as 0 for many 10s windows and occasionally negative values (-2, -5) since ~02:14 UTC. TTFT panel empty. They also saw intermittent 502s on the API. Customer is on Dedicated.
aya_engineer: Can you paste the console permalink + org id and the exact time range? also any repro steps the customer gave?
carl_support: permalink: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/org_acme_42/dashboards/telemetry?from=2026-03-15T02:00Z&to=2026-03-15T03:00Z
Customer said: "metrics dropped to 0, then some windows turning negative, app experienced higher latency and 502s around 02:17". Org id: org_acme_42. Repro: query dashboard only — they didn't change anything.
deploy-bot: consumer-group acme-telemetry-rollups restarted (leader election) at 2026-03-15T02:16:40Z — reason: broker disconnect
jonah_oncall: sounds like a rollup/consumer offset hiccup after the restart. Negative deltas usually mean overlapping windows or counter resets. Can we check raw rollup events and the rollup worker logs for duplicate window writes?
carl_support: Here's a small excerpt from the rollup consumer log around the time (sanitized):
```
[02:16:39] Partition 3 committed offset 124556
[02:16:40] Consumer restart
[02:16:41] Processing window 2026-03-15T02:16:00Z-02:16:10Z -> total_tokens=1024
[02:16:41] Processing window 2026-03-15T02:16:00Z-02:16:10Z -> total_tokens=1019
[02:16:42] Write window delta -> previous_total missing, delta = -5
```
samir_infra: if two workers processed the same window due to a leader flip and we compute delta by subtracting last-committed sum (without partition-scoped monotonic counters), you get negatives. Quick mitigation: clamp deltas to 0 in the aggregation layer and mark a ticket to dedupe overlapping writes.
aya_engineer: I pulled the rollup table for org_acme_42 around that range. Confirmed duplicate writes for the same window with slightly different totals. Looks like our checkpoint commit happened slightly behind, so the worker reprocessed and wrote a second row; downstream rollup aggregator treated it as a new total and computed delta against the later value leading to negative result.
mira_sre: For customer communication — propose: 1) temporary console query filter to clamp negatives: e.g. use GREATEST(tok_delta, 0) or dashboard transform, 2) schedule a backfill job to recompute deltas for the affected windows, and 3) patch: make rollup consumer write idempotent (include leader epoch + window id) and update delta calc to be monotonic per-partition.
carl_support: I'll tell Acme the workaround + ETA. Can we get an eng PR and a backfill plan today? I want to give them an ETA by EOD.
aya_engineer: I'll open a PR for idempotent writes and add per-partition monotonic counters. samir_infra — can you draft the backfill query? I'll link the PR to the ticket.
samir_infra: Drafted query and backfill steps:
```
-- mark duplicates and recompute
WITH latest_per_partition AS (
  SELECT partition, window_start, max(total_tokens) as total_tokens
  FROM rollups
  WHERE org='org_acme_42' AND window_start >= '2026-03-15T02:00:00Z' AND window_start < '2026-03-15T03:00:00Z'
  GROUP BY partition, window_start
)
UPDATE rollup_deltas SET tok_delta = GREATEST(new_total - prev_total, 0)
FROM ... -- joined logic
```
samir_infra: I'll run this in dry-run and share results before making changes.
carl_support: awesome — please keep me posted, ping me when dry-run looks good and I'll update Acme. :thumbsup:
